summary: Uxin Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing that an entity controlled by its Chairman and CEO, Mr. Kun Dai, adopted a Rule 10b5-1 purchase plan to buy up to US$5 million of the Company's American Depositary Shares at no more than US$2.85 per ADS. The plan was entered into on June 30, 2026, with purchases authorized to commence after a 90-day cooling-off period on September 28, 2026, under the Company's insider trading policy. There is no board recommendation or advisor named; this is a pre-arranged personal trading arrangement, not a corporate special situation. What to watch: the plan's execution depends on price conditions, but this is a routine insider plan adoption, not a transformative event.
